name: cursor-magnetic-button
title: Magnetic Button
description: Khi con trỏ vào vùng hút, cả nút nghiêng lệch về phía con trỏ (tối đa 12 px), chữ trong nút lệch thêm một nửa; ra khỏi vùng thì nút nảy về giữa bằng lò xo.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio magnetic-button, written here): Pill button 120x44 at centre, magnetic radius 74 px (dashed). Inside the radius, target offset = (cursor − centre) × 0.18, clamped to 12 px; outside it is 0. The button follows the target on a spring k240 c22 (mass 1; about 420 ms back). The label moves an extra half of the button offset (1.5× total). Cursor 3.6 s, power2.inOut per leg: (292,172) hold to 0.3, (214,74) 0.9, (186,124) 1.5, (126,78) 2.1, (36,44) 2.6, (70,184) 3.05, (292,172) 3.6. Params: radius (74 px) · pull (0.18) · max (12 px) · label (+0.5 × độ lệch nút) · spring (k240 c22) · path [[giây, x, y]]. The label moves an extra half of the button's offset; the spring is integrated from the start, so each frame is a function of time.
